metadata.oracle_evidence: solution/trajectory.npz replays a physical Sharpa Wave serving trajectory in both modes (874 rows; the episode ends at success after 724 controls; standard: the same rows submitted through the public client). It passes two fresh-process replays with identical state hashes, also succeeds with float32-rounded rows, and the Harbor oracle scored 1 in both modes.

notes.layout: Both hands hang from the same six-axis wrist stage (world-frame x, y, z slides in metres, then serial X, Y, Z hinges in radians), with the same joint ranges, gains and start targets; the reset grasp of the turner is hand-specific.
